welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: The Spot for Active Pleasure-Seekers
welcome.text1: Hotel Mulin sits in the heart of Brigels, one of the most beautiful mountain villages of the Surselva. Our stunning alpine world offers both: adventure for the active and rest for connoisseurs.
welcome.text2: Start your day with the Muliniala breakfast buffet, explore mountains, trails and slopes, and let the evening fade away by the fireplace in the Mulinera lounge.

rooms.label: Our Rooms
rooms.title: Choose Your Perfect Room
rooms.subtitle: From cosy single rooms to spacious family rooms — find your perfect home in the mountains.
rooms.tab_superior_twin: Superior Double or Twin with Mountain View
rooms.name_superior_twin: Superior Double or Twin with Mountain View
rooms.desc_single: Cosy room for solo travellers with all the comfort for a relaxing stay in the heart of Brigels.
rooms.desc_standard_double: Comfortable double room with everything you need for a pleasant stay. Perfect for couples.
rooms.desc_superior_double: Spacious room with premium amenities including minibar and safe. Our most popular room category.
rooms.desc_superior_twin: Elegant twin room with private balcony and stunning mountain views. Two comfortable single beds for flexible sleeping arrangements.
rooms.desc_family_3: Spacious family room with three single beds, ideal for small families or groups. All the comforts for a relaxed stay.
rooms.desc_family_4: Our largest family room with 3-4 beds and a private balcony. Crib available on request. Ideal for families with young children.
rooms.desc_sgln: Cosy single room (approx. 12 m²) with a 120 cm wide bed, heated floors and your own coffee & tea machine. Ideal for solo travellers.
rooms.desc_sglb: Spacious single room with a wide 140 cm bed — more space and comfort for solo travellers who like it roomy.
rooms.desc_dbln: Comfortable double room (approx. 22 m²) with a large double bed, seating area and views of the village or mountains. Perfect for couples.
rooms.desc_dbrb: Double room with private balcony and mountain view — enjoy your morning coffee overlooking the Grisons alps. Dogs welcome.
rooms.desc_glrs: Spacious suite (approx. 31 m²) with separate living and sleeping areas: double bed on the gallery, sofa and balcony with mountain view.
rooms.desc_fam6: Our largest room for up to 6 guests — ideal for families and small groups exploring the Surselva together.

pricing.title: Prices and Reservation
pricing.subtitle: All room rates include breakfast buffet, city tax, service charges and VAT.
pricing.includes: Muliniala breakfast buffet, city tax & Wi-Fi included
pricing.dogs: Dogs are very welcome (CHF 25/night) — dog bed and bowls provided
pricing.loyalty: Best price guarantee when booking direct on hotelmulin.ch

dining.label: Breakfast Muliniala
dining.title: Energy for Your Adventures
dining.text: Our Muliniala breakfast buffet treats you every morning to regional specialities from the Surselva — fresh bread, Grisons cheese and meats, homemade jams and much more. The perfect start to an active day in the mountains.
dining.menu_subtitle: Swiss specialities served in a cosy atmosphere
dining.fondue_desc: Traditional Swiss cheese fondue with Gruyère & Vacherin, served with fresh bread and accompaniments.
dining.fondue_wine_desc: Cheese fondue for two including a bottle of selected Swiss wine — the perfect experience.
dining.raclette_desc: Original Valais raclette with potatoes, gherkins and pearl onions.
dining.flammkuchen_desc: Crispy Alsatian-style tarte flambée with crème fraîche, bacon and onions.
dining.pizza_desc: Fresh from the oven — various pizzas with homemade dough and top-quality ingredients.
dining.noodles_desc: Quick snack anytime — hot water included.
dining.menu_note: Lunch and dinner available on request. Please let us know when booking or at reception.
dining.lounge_text: After a day in the mountains, the Mulinera lounge welcomes you with a crackling fireplace, trendy cocktails and a fine selection of wines. Cigar lovers enjoy the «La Pipa» smoking corner.

wellness.label: Activities
wellness.title: Adventure Right on the Doorstep
wellness.text: Brigels is a paradise for active guests all year round: bike trails, hiking paths and the golf course in summer, the Brigels-Waltensburg-Andiast ski area right outside the door in winter. Our team is happy to put together your personal weekly programme.

location.label: Location
location.title: In the Heart of Brigels and the Surselva
location.subtitle: On the sunny plateau of Brigels, surrounded by the mountains of the Surselva.
location.desc: Brigels sits on a sunny plateau at 1,300 m above sea level in the Surselva. Mountain railways, ski area, bike trails and the golf course are just minutes away.
